scope: Initial teacher-forcing CPU reference capture, before any optimized backend acceptance. Small owned code/Russian corpora are diagnostic coverage, not whole-model quality certification.
reference: Host native CPU, same pinned model SHA/template/token IDs, original weight buffers, F16 KV, no GPU
candidate: Product APK CPU profile; identical prompt and teacher-forced continuation token IDs
rationale: Provisional screening budget fixed before reference collection: small differences in log probabilities, with a stricter mean and a bounded worst token. Preserve failures; investigate rather than widening bounds to accept a backend. Larger corpora/task quality remain separate gates.
